title: The theta series of an even unimodular lattice is a Siegel modular form
abstract: Let L be an even unimodular lattice of rank 2k and n a finite index type. The theta series Θ_L(Z) = ∑_{x ∈ Lⁿ} exp(πi tr(G(x)Z)), G(x) the Gram matrix of the tuple x, converges absolutely when Im Z is positive definite, is holomorphic in the entries of Z, is bounded on each region Im Z ≥ c·1, and satisfies Θ_L((AZ + B)(CZ + D)⁻¹) = det(CZ + D)^k Θ_L(Z) for every (A B; C D) in Sp(2n, ℤ) and every Z in the Siegel upper half-space. So Θ_L is a Siegel modular form of degree n and weight k. The transformation law is proved on three kinds of generator. Translations Z ↦ Z + S and the maps Z ↦ UZUᵀ are reindexings of the sum. The inversion Z ↦ −Z⁻¹ is reduced to the inversion formula for a theta series in one variable: for Z = τ·Y with Y real positive definite, Θ_L(Z) is the one-variable theta series of the lattice Lⁿ twisted by a square root of Y, to which TauCeti's inversion formula (Poisson summation) applies; the identity theorem along the path s ↦ s·Re Z + i·Im Z then gives all of the Siegel upper half-space. Finally Sp(2n, ℤ) is generated by the inversion, the translations and the image of GL(n, ℤ).
